chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, who said:

I asked Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) about the man who has four wives and divorces one of them: Can he marry another in her place? He (peace be upon him) said: No, until her waiting period expires.
ai.seo_question: Can a man with four wives marry a new wife immediately after divorcing one?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that a man with four wives must wait for the full expiration of the *iddah* (waiting period) of the divorced wife before marrying a new one, preventing the accumulation of more than four concurrent marital ties. This ruling ensures the preservation of the Quranic limit of four wives by treating the new marriage as a distinct contract that begins only after the previous bond is legally dissolved. The requirement underscores the importance of the *iddah* not merely as a period of potential reconciliation, but as a structural boundary for maintaining the specific count of wives permitted in Islamic law.
